subject: Re: Kickoff: pruning toolkit — closing decisions
body:
Team,

Decisions to close by May 18:

1) The recommendation report ships with a two-tier guidance: magnitude pruning as the default up to 80% sparsity (simpler, no quality gap), gradient-based for anything above — Vera's 90% comparison with the 1.1-point advantage is the dividing line. Her final report lands Friday.
2) The warm-restart threshold fix goes into the library defaults before we call the toolkit "supported." Nobody should have to learn that failure mode from a chart in our appendix.
3) Scope cut: the block-sparsity throughput benchmarks cover the serving hardware we actually run, not the full matrix Jorge sketched. The exotic accelerator column moves to a Q3 item — OKR planning locks Jun 26 and I'd rather propose it there properly.

Good window, team. Pilot 3 starts under the efficiency banner in June.

Zofia
